metadata.purpose: Prove that a human correction becomes shared memory for a new browser agent session.
metadata.learner_outcome: By the end, the viewer can see search_wiki, read_page, human authorization, Git revision, and a fresh-session readback.
metadata.source_policy: Use real deployed UI and real tool operations as evidence; use no fabricated UI.
metadata.publication_target: Public YouTube demo under three minutes with clear audio.

beats.teaching_purpose: Establish the deployed entry point and the real WebMCP environment.
beats.spoken_content: This is HatWiki, a live Git-native Wiki where people and browser agents maintain shared knowledge together. We will use the deployed site and a browser agent with WebMCP enabled.

narration_spine.name: English opening pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a human voiceover after the live URL and WebMCP host are verified.
narration_spine.acceptance: The opening names HatWiki, the live environment, and the WebMCP context in one clear sentence.

visual_slots.name: Live HatWiki home and Knowledge Loom
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the deployed HatWiki home page without private browser data.
visual_slots.acceptance: The live URL, HatWiki identity, and Knowledge Loom are readable.

beats.teaching_purpose: State the viewer promise before showing implementation details.
beats.spoken_content: Agent conversations are useful, but their context is temporary. HatWiki turns important decisions into inspectable Wiki pages with citations, links, and Git history.

narration_spine.name: English product promise pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a human voiceover against the home page and final-state reference frame.
narration_spine.acceptance: The product promise is understandable without naming implementation libraries.

visual_slots.name: Human-facing Wiki index
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the public Wiki index and one readable page.
visual_slots.acceptance: A viewer can see this is a usable Wiki, not only a tool registration screen.

beats.teaching_purpose: Define one repeatable task and its success evidence.
beats.spoken_content: Our task is to improve an existing human-written research page, preserve its evidence boundary, and make the corrected result available to a new agent session.

narration_spine.name: English task setup pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a concise task statement over the selected Wiki page.
narration_spine.acceptance: The task names the existing page, the human decision, and the fresh-session readback.

visual_slots.name: Selected Agent2UCB page and source citation
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the real page, citation, and revision fields after the demo page is fixed for recording.
visual_slots.acceptance: The selected page is clearly an existing page with source context.

beats.teaching_purpose: Show the browser agent discovering and reading the page through WebMCP.
beats.spoken_content: Find the existing Agent2UCB page using HatWiki's tools. Then read it and summarize the evidence boundary in three bullets. The agent searches first and reads the canonical page instead of guessing from chat context.

narration_spine.name: English WebMCP explanation pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record human narration after a real WebMCP host completes search_wiki followed by read_page.
narration_spine.acceptance: The recording visibly proves both tool calls and shows structured page ID, citations, and revision.

visual_slots.name: WebMCP search and read evidence
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the real external agent host and redact private session details.
visual_slots.acceptance: search_wiki and read_page names, inputs, and bounded results are readable.

beats.teaching_purpose: Make the human safety decision visible before any write operation.
beats.spoken_content: Propose one small clarification, but do not publish until I approve the exact text. HatWiki separates agent assistance from publication and keeps the human decision visible.

narration_spine.name: English authorization boundary pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record the agent proposal and the human approval prompt in one uninterrupted take.
narration_spine.acceptance: The agent stops before the write call and the proposed text is readable.

visual_slots.name: Proposed clarification before approval
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the real agent proposal and the explicit approval boundary.
visual_slots.acceptance: No write operation occurs before the on-screen human approval.

beats.teaching_purpose: Show the approved write, the permission boundary, and the durable Git result.
beats.spoken_content: I approve this exact sentence. Publish it to HatWiki using edit_page. After approval, the authenticated server validates the change and records a Git-backed revision.

narration_spine.name: English write-path pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record the real authenticated edit_page call only after Gate A write UX is verified.
narration_spine.acceptance: The authorization field, result status, page revision, and Git commit or diff are all visible.

visual_slots.name: Authenticated edit and Git revision
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the real write flow, then show the public readback and GitHub revision without exposing credentials.
visual_slots.acceptance: The result is verifiable as committed, not merely a success message fabricated in the video.

unresolved_work.name: Gate A write-flow evidence
unresolved_work.production_method: Complete and test the visible authenticated edit flow, including diff or preview and committed/conflict/approval_required result.
unresolved_work.acceptance: A real external WebMCP host can complete the write using the same signed-in session.

beats.teaching_purpose: Prove that the shared state survives a new agent session and remains traceable.
beats.spoken_content: Now I open a fresh agent session. It can read the updated page, the citation, and the new revision without inheriting the previous conversation. The shared memory is the Wiki and Git history, not the chat transcript.

narration_spine.name: English fresh-session validation pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a new browser-agent session reading the updated public page after the write has fully propagated.
narration_spine.acceptance: The fresh session reads the corrected sentence and reports the current revision and source.

visual_slots.name: Fresh-session readback
visual_slots.production_method: Capture a new session and the updated public page after commit, GitHub readback, and R2 publication.
visual_slots.acceptance: The second session visibly reads the new state without relying on the first session's transcript.

unresolved_work.name: Gate C fresh-session evidence
unresolved_work.production_method: Run the complete write, public readback, and fresh WebMCP session against the deployed revision.
unresolved_work.acceptance: The updated page, citation, and revision are available to a new session.

beats.teaching_purpose: Close on the durable product pattern and give the viewer a verifiable next step.
beats.spoken_content: HatWiki demonstrates a practical WebMCP pattern: agents help maintain shared knowledge, people control publication, and every public result remains inspectable through the Wiki, citations, and Git history.

narration_spine.name: English closing pickup
narration_spine.production_method: Record a short human closing over the updated page and Knowledge Loom.
narration_spine.acceptance: The final sentence names the human/agent boundary and points to the live demo and public repository.

visual_slots.name: Updated page, Knowledge Loom, and repository link
visual_slots.production_method: Capture the final verified state and the public project link.
visual_slots.acceptance: The video ends on a verifiable product state, not a generic title card.
